"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect the intellectual property rights of artists, creators, and inventors at home and abroad.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will increase access to global markets for American intellectual property and other digital trade by opposing quotas, discriminatory measures, and data localization requirements.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are immensely proud of all that the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) has done through its achievements in science, technology and exploration to better understand the country's place in the universe and inspire and educate generations of young people in the country to pursue careers in science.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Space exploration is a reminder that the country's capacity for curiosity is limitless, and may be matched only by the ability to achieve great things if people work together.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe in continuing the spirit of discovery that has animated NASA's exploration of space over the last half century.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will strengthen support for NASA and work in partnership with the international scientific community to launch new missions to space.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
